title: Define and consume one API contract; do not mark UI done until wired to real endpoint
body: UI work implementing a parallel frontend contract instead of the packaged endpoint appears complete but breaks on integration. Do not close a UI ticket until the UI reads from the real API response shape and integration is verified end-to-end.
source_ref: rules.md:R24; lessons — 'Kanban UI must consume the packaged API shape, not a parallel contract'
